currentParagraphText: “Fair enough,” Jake said, not even bothering to comment on the fact that apparently bribery was simply viewed as a normal way to get a store within Order territory. Instead, he switched the topic. “Say, how are you doing after digesting your gains from your fight with Yip of Yore? Everything as it should be?”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: This was Jake’s first time meeting the snake god after he killed Yip, and Jake could feel some subtle changes to Villy’s aura. He couldn’t quite place his finger on why it felt different, but something had undoubtedly changed.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Who said I bought it? Lots of the larger merchant organizations have begun to expand their presence within Order territory recently, and this batch was part of their bribery to be allowed to set up shop,” the snake god answered casually. “I just swiped it from one of the warehouses as the quality seemed good.”
